aboutIntro: Software Engineer and full-stack MERN developer with a BSCS foundation in data structures, object-oriented design, databases, and software engineering. I build RESTful APIs and database-backed applications using React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and MySQL, with a focus on JWT/RBAC, automated testing, and deterministic recommendation systems.
